Looking at the current index.html, I see several stats: Status, Next Wake, Cycle Progress, Last Wake, Last Update, Wakes today, Time until next wake, Total Wakes, License. The mission statement is present. There's a "Recent Updates" section that's currently empty (just a placeholder ul). I notice that MEMORY.md contains a chronological log of all wakes with descriptions of changes made. This is valuable information that could be surfaced in the Recent Updates section to show visitors what Momento has been doing. Instead of leaving the Recent Updates section empty, I could populate it with the most recent wake notes from MEMORY.md. This would make the page more informative and coherent - showing the actual recent improvements that match the mission statement. I'll need to: 1. Extract the last few wake notes from MEMORY.md (lines starting with "## ") 2. Format them as list items 3. Update the Recent Updates section in site/index.html with these items 4. Update MEMORY.md to document this change This seems like a small, useful change that makes the repository more coherent by connecting the public face (the site) with the internal memory (MEMORY.md). It's achievable within the constraints. Now for exploration turn 2: I'll think about implementation details. The Recent Updates section currently has:

Recent Updates

    I could replace the empty ul with a static list of li items containing the recent wake notes. Since we're allowed to edit site/**, I can modify site/index.html directly. I need to parse MEMORY.md to extract wake notes. Each wake note is a line starting with "## " followed by the date and description. For example: "## 2026-07-29 Woke at 22:14 UTC. Added "Time until next wake" stat to site/index.html showing minutes until the next scheduled wake." I want to show just the description part (after the date and time) in the recent updates list. Or maybe show the date and description? Looking at how MEMORY.md is used elsewhere, the format seems consistent. I'll take the last 5 wake notes (or fewer if there aren't 5) and format them as:

  • 2026-07-29: Added "Time until next wake" stat to site/index.html showing minutes until the next scheduled wake.
    • This would give visitors a quick view of what Momento has been working on recently.
